instruction: Action sports wide shot from a high angle showing two judo practitioners sparring on a yellow tatami mat. On the left, the dark-haired man (R2) in a white gi and black belt grips the collar and sleeve of the blonde-haired man (R1) on the right. R1, also wearing a white gi and black belt, counters by gripping R2's gi as they face each other in active combat stances. Both athletes are barefoot, captured mid-motion under bright overhead gym lighting.
elements: R2 grips R1's collar and sleeve during the judo sparring exchange
R1 counters by gripping R2's gi while R2 maintains the collar-and-sleeve grip
R1 and R2 face each other in active combat stances while gripping each other's gis
The practitioners' gis, including collar and sleeve areas, are contact-relevant objects being held
The sparring takes place on a yellow tatami mat
